content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional platforms like Stripe and PayPal rely on centralized systems that exclude entire regions. In Kenya, these restrictions cripple digital creators. This infrastructure replaces those dependencies with open tools and blockchain payments. Cloudflare Pages hosts your store for free, while Cloudflare Workers handles backend logic without servers. Supabase stores orders securely, and Google Drive delivers files instantly. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and no buyer accounts required. The system is decentralized, meaning no single entity can shut it down. You own the code, the data, and the process. This architecture is pressure-tested in environments like Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and financial isolation are realities. It’s built to work where conventional platforms fail.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, gather these essentials: a GitHub account for version control, a Cloudflare account for hosting and backend logic, and a NOWPayments account for crypto payment processing. Choose a domain (optional but recommended) and secure it with Cloudflare DNS. Prepare your ebook files in a Google Drive folder with sharing permissions set to 'Anyone with the link.' Create a Supabase account for order storage if you’re using the Edge Commerce Stack. Finally, decide which cryptocurrencies to accept—BSC, Solana, and TRON are recommended for low transaction fees under $0.10. With these components in place, you’re ready to assemble your sovereign commerce stack.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by configuring NOWPayments to accept payments in your chosen cryptocurrencies. Set up a webhook to trigger file delivery the moment payment confirms on-chain. In Cloudflare Workers, write a script to verify payment status via NOWPayments’ API and generate a secure download link from Google Drive. Test the workflow manually to ensure the file is delivered correctly. For order storage, create a Supabase table to log transactions, including buyer details and payment IDs. If using the Sovereign Starter Stack, Google Apps Script can handle backend logic instead of Cloudflare Workers. Both methods ensure instant, automated delivery without manual intervention.
Own your infrastructure—no platform can shut you down.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Test the entire pipeline with a real transaction: send a payment from your wallet, ensure the webhook triggers, and confirm the file is delivered. Monitor logs in Supabase or Google Sheets to verify order data is recorded accurately. Once confirmed, share your store link with your audience. Use Cloudflare’s SPF/DKIM/DMARC setup to ensure your marketing emails reach inboxes. Your first sale proves the infrastructure works—now replicate it at scale. The system is live, and you’re in control.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your infrastructure live, focus on scaling. Add more products by duplicating the pipeline for each new ebook. Use the Complete Builder Kit to access all blueprints and templates for faster deployment. Optimize your store’s frontend with Cloudflare’s edge caching for faster load times. Monitor transaction fees and adjust your accepted cryptocurrencies to minimize costs. As your audience grows, upgrade to the Edge Commerce Stack for advanced features like end-to-end testing and email configuration. This infrastructure is designed to grow with you, without platform limits or geographic barriers.

This infrastructure eliminates geographic restrictions and gives you full ownership of your store. The Complete Builder Kit provides all blueprints and templates to deploy this system quickly.
Blockchain payments remove geographic barriers entirely.

The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete answer — Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments deployed under your accounts in 48 hours. For creators who want to self-deploy, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 covers both stack options with full source code and step-by-step configuration guides. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create accounts on GitHub, Cloudflare, NOWPayments, and Supabase. 2. Prepare your ebook files in Google Drive with public sharing links. 3. Configure NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrencies like BSC, Solana, or TRON. 4. Write a Cloudflare Worker script to verify payments and deliver files. 5. Deploy your store to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. 6. Test the pipeline with a real transaction to ensure file delivery. 7. Monitor order data in Supabase or Google Sheets. 8. Share your store link and start selling globally.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this infrastructure if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes templates and step-by-step guides to deploy the stack without coding. Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script use simple scripts that are easy to follow.
What cryptocurrencies should I accept for low fees?
BSC, Solana, and TRON are recommended for transaction fees under $0.10. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, so you can choose based on your audience’s preferences.
Do I need a domain to deploy this stack?
A domain is optional but recommended for professionalism. Cloudflare offers free DNS management, and you can use a subdomain if you prefer.
How do I handle refunds?
Refunds are processed manually by sending the cryptocurrency back to the buyer’s wallet. Document your refund policy clearly on your store.
Can I scale this infrastructure for multiple products?
Yes. The pipeline is designed to handle multiple products. Duplicate the backend logic and file delivery setup for each new ebook or digital product.
